categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Touches BlockTemplateManager and getblocktemplate cache logic with the Mining label.
categories.rationale: Encapsulates function-local static cache into BlockTemplateManager and eliminates lifetime issues in multi-node test setups. The description notes that 'cached CBlockIndex* can outlive the ChainstateManager that owns it' and this refactoring moves global state into the node context as part of #33758 while enabling unit testing of cache invalidation.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Edits src/rpc/mining.cpp only to delegate template caching to node internals, without changing RPC interfaces or protocols.
categories.rationale: Does not touch RPC protocol machinery or caller-facing behavior; the mining RPC merely exposes template generation that belongs to the mining subsystem.
